A [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Realization AD" /> '''individual''' was the [[governor]] of a [[Unidentified settlement (rocky planet)|settlement]] on a [[Unidentified rocky planet (Inquisitors)|rocky world]]. Around [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Inquisitor]]s [[Fourth Sister]] and [[Barriss Offee]] visited the world in search of [[Unidentified human Jedi|a Jedi]] connected to a local [[Unidentified rebel cell|rebel cell]]. The two [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] [[agent]]s questioned the townspeople, including the governor, with Fourth Sister threatneing their lives if they did not turn over the Jedi. However, the governor was unrelenting, and he was [[Death|killed]] by the Fourth Sister for refusing to divulge the [[Jedi]]'s location.<ref name="Realization" />
